# Trail Cleanup and Data Cockpit Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Remove the Unit 10 popups and the Unit 1→10 darkening from the home page trail, and turn the top of `/data.html` into a spaceship cockpit with unit lights and a Launch control.

**Architecture:** The trail markup is generated by `scripts/build-trail.mjs` (never hand-edit `index.html` between `trail:begin`/`trail:end`); its runtime is `assets/js/path-trail.js`. Removal happens in the generator, the runtime, `home-path.css`, and the tests that pinned the old behaviour. The cockpit is static markup emitted by `scripts/build-data-course.cjs`, styled by a new `assets/css/cockpit.css`, and driven by a new classic script `assets/js/cockpit.js` whose state logic is a pure function exposed on `window.PyPathCockpit` for vitest.

**Tech Stack:** Plain HTML/CSS/JS (no framework, no build step for site code), vitest + jsdom, Playwright (Node and Python) for browser checks.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-trail-cleanup-and-data-cockpit-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Owner's rule: small commits, each pushed to `main` (Vercel deploys `main`). Never add Co-Authored-By, Claude-Session or "Generated with" lines to commit messages.
- Before any push that changed CSS or JS: `python3 scripts/bake_layout.py`, and every changed asset must be in the versioned list in `version_course_assets()` in `scripts/bake_layout.py`.
- Trail markup only via `node scripts/build-trail.mjs`; `node scripts/build-trail.mjs --check` must pass.
- `data.html` only via `node scripts/build-data-course.cjs` (it also rewrites the 60 data lesson pages and `assets/data/curriculum-data.json`; those must come out byte-identical apart from intended changes — check `git status`).
- Nothing may animate under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (`npm run test:motion`).
- a11y budget is zero (`npm run test:a11y`).
- Foundations map keeps the `--day-*` palette for Units 1–10 in both site themes; Python for Data keeps `--night-*` for 11–20.
- Data unit test records are keyed `data-N` in `pypath-unit-tests`; Foundations are keyed `N`.

## Review Focus

1. A returning visitor whose `pypath-course` is `data` must still resume at stop 11 with no dialog and no thrown error (resume code used to set `dataAccepted`).
2. Keyboard focus moving onto a Python for Data card while on Foundations must scroll the trail to that stop, never leave focus on an invisible card.
3. In the dark site theme, Unit 10 of Foundations must still use the dark-theme **day** palette (the removed `is-night-altitude` override was what changed it).
4. Corrupt or missing progress JSON on `/data.html` must leave all lights dim and Launch pointing at Unit 1, with no exception.
5. Ctrl/Cmd/Shift/middle-click on Launch must open the unit normally with no animation; a double click must not navigate twice.

- [ ] **Step 7: Rewrite the browser contract**

Replace `tests/browser/trail_transition.mjs` with:

```js
/* Real-browser contract for moving between courses on the trail: no dialog,
   the seam hands straight over to Python for Data, and the hero swaps to the
   moon exactly when the data course is the active one.
   Run against npm run serve: node tests/browser/trail_transition.mjs [base] */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
const base = process.argv[2] || 'http://localhost:8080';
const browser = await chromium.launch();
try {
  for (const [width, reducedMotion] of [[1440, 'reduce'], [390, 'reduce'], [1440, 'no-preference']]) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width, height: 900 }, reducedMotion });
    await context.addInitScript(() => { try { localStorage.setItem('pypath.locale', 'en'); } catch {} });
    const page = await context.newPage();
    await page.goto(base);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => window.PyPathTrail);
    const at = (i) => page.evaluate((n) => window.PyPathTrail.progressForStop(n), i);

    // Scroll past Unit 10: nothing opens, Unit 11 lights.
    await page.evaluate(async (p) => window.PyPathTrail.scrollToProgress(p), await at(10));
    await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('dialog[open]').count(), 0, 'no dialog may open on the trail');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.path-stop-card.is-active').getAttribute('data-stop-index'), '10');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('html').getAttribute('data-course'), 'data');

    // Back to Foundations.
    await page.evaluate(async (p) => window.PyPathTrail.scrollToProgress(p), await at(9));
    await page.waitForTimeout(150);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.path-stop-card.is-active').getAttribute('data-stop-index'), '9');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('html').getAttribute('data-course'), null);

    // Keyboard focus onto a data card scrolls to it.
    await page.locator('[data-stop-card][data-stop-index="12"] a').focus();
    await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.path-stop-card.is-active').getAttribute('data-stop-index'), '12');

    // Hero swaps exclusively between moon and mountain.
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
    await page.waitForTimeout(150);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.home-summit__moon').isVisible(), true);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.home-summit__art').count(), 0, 'mountain image must leave the DOM');
    await page.locator('[data-trail-jump="1"]').click();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('html').getAttribute('data-course'), null);
    await page.waitForTimeout(150);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.home-summit__mountain').count(), 1);
    console.log(`${width}px (${reducedMotion}): no dialog, seam to 11, focus, moon/mountain passed`);
    await context.close();
  }

  // A returning data learner resumes on Unit 11 without any prompt.
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
  await context.addInitScript(() => { try { localStorage.setItem('pypath.locale', 'en'); localStorage.setItem('pypath-course', 'data'); } catch {} });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(String(e)));
  await page.goto(base);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.PyPathTrail);
  await page.evaluate(() => window.PyPathTrail.scrollToProgress(window.PyPathTrail.progressForStop(10)));
  await page.waitForTimeout(150);
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.path-stop-card.is-active').getAttribute('data-stop-index'), '10');
  assert.equal(await page.locator('dialog[open]').count(), 0);
  assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
  console.log('resume on data course passed');
  await context.close();
} finally { await browser.close(); }
```

```js
/* The Foundations map looks the same at Unit 10 as at Unit 1, in both themes.
   Run against npm run serve: node tests/browser/trail_daylight.mjs [base] */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
const base = process.argv[2] || 'http://localhost:8080';
const browser = await chromium.launch();
try {
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark']) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
    await context.addInitScript((t) => { try { localStorage.setItem('pypath.locale', 'en'); localStorage.setItem('pypath-theme', t); } catch {} }, theme);
    const page = await context.newPage();
    await page.goto(base);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => window.PyPathTrail);
    await page.evaluate((t) => { document.documentElement.dataset.theme = t; }, theme);
    const look = async (stop) => {
      await page.evaluate((n) => window.PyPathTrail.scrollToProgress(window.PyPathTrail.progressForStop(n)), stop);
      await page.waitForTimeout(250);
      return page.evaluate(() => {
        const svg = document.querySelector('.path-map[data-segment="1"]');
        const cs = getComputedStyle(svg);
        const map = document.querySelector('.path-journey__map');
        return {
          base: cs.getPropertyValue('--trail-base').trim(),
          dot: cs.getPropertyValue('--trail-dot').trim(),
          lit: cs.getPropertyValue('--trail-lit').trim(),
          bg: getComputedStyle(map).backgroundColor,
          night: document.querySelector('.path-journey').classList.contains('is-night-altitude'),
        };
      });
    };
    const first = await look(0);
    const last = await look(9);
    assert.equal(last.night, false);
    assert.deepEqual(last, first, `Unit 10 must match Unit 1 in ${theme} theme`);
    console.log(`${theme}: Unit 10 palette matches Unit 1`);
    await context.close();
  }
} finally { await browser.close(); }
```

(The theme storage key is set defensively; the `dataset.theme` assignment is what the test relies on.)

### Task 3: Cockpit state logic

**Files:**
- Create: `assets/js/cockpit.js`
- Test: `tests/cockpit.test.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces `window.PyPathCockpit.state(units, passedPaths, testRecords, passMark)`:
  - `units`: `Array<{ n: number, title: string, href: string, lessons: string[] }>` in order 1–10
  - `passedPaths`: `string[]` of lesson paths whose lesson passed
  - `testRecords`: the parsed `pypath-unit-tests` object (keys `'data-3'` etc.)
  - `passMark`: number (70)
  - returns `{ lights: Array<'done'|'current'|'idle'>, target: unit, label: string }`
- Produces `window.PyPathCockpit.readProgress()` → `{ passedPaths: string[], testRecords: object }`, never throws.

Rules: a unit is **done** when every lesson in `lessons` is in `passedPaths` and its `data-N` record has `best >= passMark` (or `passed === true` when `best` is absent). The **current** unit is the first unit not done. If every unit is done there is no current light and `target` is unit 1 with label `Launch again: Unit 1, <title>`. Otherwise `label` is `Launch: Unit N, <title>`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

```js
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';

let C;
const units = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
  n: i + 1,
  title: `Unit title ${i + 1}`,
  href: `/data/unit-${i + 1}.html`,
  lessons: [`/data/unit-${i + 1}/a.html`, `/data/unit-${i + 1}/b.html`],
}));
const all = (n) => units[n - 1].lessons;

beforeAll(() => {
  new Function(fs.readFileSync('assets/js/cockpit.js', 'utf8')).call(window);
  C = window.PyPathCockpit;
});

describe('cockpit state', () => {
  it('points a new learner at Unit 1', () => {
    const s = C.state(units, [], {}, 70);
    expect(s.lights).toEqual(['current', ...Array(9).fill('idle')]);
    expect(s.target.n).toBe(1);
    expect(s.label).toBe('Launch: Unit 1, Unit title 1');
  });

  it('needs both every lesson and the test for a unit to be done', () => {
    const lessonsOnly = C.state(units, all(1), {}, 70);
    expect(lessonsOnly.lights[0]).toBe('current');
    const both = C.state(units, all(1), { 'data-1': { best: 82 } }, 70);
    expect(both.lights.slice(0, 2)).toEqual(['done', 'current']);
    expect(both.target.n).toBe(2);
  });

  it('ignores Foundations test records with the same number', () => {
    const s = C.state(units, all(1), { 1: { best: 100 } }, 70);
    expect(s.lights[0]).toBe('current');
  });

  it('treats a failing best score as not passed and passed:true without a score as passed', () => {
    expect(C.state(units, all(1), { 'data-1': { best: 64 } }, 70).lights[0]).toBe('current');
    expect(C.state(units, all(1), { 'data-1': { passed: true } }, 70).lights[0]).toBe('done');
  });

  it('sends a learner who skipped ahead to the first unfinished unit', () => {
    const s = C.state(units, [...all(2)], { 'data-2': { best: 90 } }, 70);
    expect(s.lights.slice(0, 3)).toEqual(['current', 'done', 'idle']);
    expect(s.target.n).toBe(1);
  });

  it('offers a relaunch when everything is done', () => {
    const passed = units.flatMap((u) => u.lessons);
    const records = Object.fromEntries(units.map((u) => [`data-${u.n}`, { best: 100 }]));
    const s = C.state(units, passed, records, 70);
    expect(s.lights).toEqual(Array(10).fill('done'));
    expect(s.target.n).toBe(1);
    expect(s.label).toBe('Launch again: Unit 1, Unit title 1');
  });

  it('survives garbage records', () => {
    const s = C.state(units, null, 'nope', 70);
    expect(s.target.n).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('reading stored progress', () => {
  it('returns empty progress when storage holds junk', () => {
    window.ProgressStore = { getItem: () => '{not json' };
    expect(C.readProgress()).toEqual({ passedPaths: [], testRecords: {} });
    delete window.ProgressStore;
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the state logic**

Create `assets/js/cockpit.js`:

```js
/* PyPath — the cockpit at the top of /data.html.
 *
 * Ten unit lights and a Launch control. The state is computed from the same
 * local lesson map and test records the unit pages read, so a guest sees
 * their own progress. Data unit tests are stored as "data-N"; a Foundations
 * record with the same number must never light a data unit.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var LESSONS_KEY = 'pypath-progress-lessons';
  var TESTS_KEY = 'pypath-unit-tests';

  function testPassed(records, n, passMark) {
    if (!records || typeof records !== 'object' || Array.isArray(records)) return false;
    var entry = records['data-' + n];
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return false;
    var best = Number(entry.best);
    if (entry.best !== undefined && entry.best !== null && isFinite(best)) return best >= passMark;
    return entry.passed === true;
  }

  function state(units, passedPaths, testRecords, passMark) {
    var passed = {};
    (Array.isArray(passedPaths) ? passedPaths : []).forEach(function (p) { passed[p] = true; });
    var done = units.map(function (u) {
      return u.lessons.length > 0
        && u.lessons.every(function (p) { return passed[p] === true; })
        && testPassed(testRecords, u.n, passMark);
    });
    var current = done.indexOf(false);
    var lights = done.map(function (d, i) { return d ? 'done' : i === current ? 'current' : 'idle'; });
    var target = current === -1 ? units[0] : units[current];
    var label = (current === -1 ? 'Launch again: Unit ' : 'Launch: Unit ') + target.n + ', ' + target.title;
    return { lights: lights, target: target, label: label };
  }

  function readJson(key) {
    var store = window.ProgressStore || window.localStorage;
    try {
      var parsed = JSON.parse(store.getItem(key) || '{}');
      return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }

  function readProgress() {
    var LP = window.PyPathLessonProgress;
    var map = readJson(LP && LP.STORE_KEY || LESSONS_KEY);
    var passedPaths = [];
    try {
      passedPaths = LP && LP.passedLessons ? LP.passedLessons(map)
        : Object.keys(map).filter(function (k) { return map[k] && map[k].passed === true; });
    } catch (e) {
      passedPaths = [];
    }
    return { passedPaths: passedPaths, testRecords: readJson(LP && LP.UNIT_TESTS_KEY || TESTS_KEY) };
  }

  window.PyPathCockpit = { state: state, readProgress: readProgress };
})();
```

`'pypath-progress-lessons'` is `LESSON_PROGRESS_KEY` in `assets/js/storage-keys.js`; the fallback only matters when lesson-progress.js failed to load.

- [ ] **Step 2: Add the DOM wiring to `cockpit.js`**

Insert before `window.PyPathCockpit = …`, and export `render`:

```js
  function unitsFrom(root) {
    return Array.prototype.map.call(root.querySelectorAll('.cockpit__light'), function (a) {
      return {
        n: Number(a.getAttribute('data-unit')),
        title: a.getAttribute('data-title') || '',
        href: a.getAttribute('href'),
        lessons: (a.getAttribute('data-lessons') || '').split('|').filter(Boolean),
        el: a,
      };
    });
  }

  function render(doc) {
    var root = (doc || document).querySelector('[data-cockpit]');
    if (!root) return;
    var units = unitsFrom(root);
    if (!units.length) return;
    var LP = window.PyPathLessonProgress;
    var progress = readProgress();
    var s = state(units, progress.passedPaths, progress.testRecords, (LP && LP.UNIT_TEST_PASS_MARK) || 70);
    units.forEach(function (u, i) {
      u.el.setAttribute('data-state', s.lights[i]);
      if (s.lights[i] === 'current') u.el.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step');
      else u.el.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    var launch = root.querySelector('[data-cockpit-launch]');
    if (launch) {
      launch.setAttribute('href', s.target.href);
      var label = launch.querySelector('.cockpit__launch-label') || launch;
      label.textContent = s.label;
    }
  }

  function prefersReduced() {
    return !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
  }

  function wireMotion(root) {
    if (prefersReduced()) return;
    var space = root.querySelector('.cockpit__window');
    var queued = false, tx = 0, ty = 0;
    root.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;
      var r = root.getBoundingClientRect();
      tx = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5) * 2;
      ty = ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5) * 2;
      if (queued) return;
      queued = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        queued = false;
        space.style.setProperty('--look-x', tx.toFixed(3));
        space.style.setProperty('--look-y', ty.toFixed(3));
      });
    });
    root.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () {
      space.style.setProperty('--look-x', '0');
      space.style.setProperty('--look-y', '0');
    });
    var launch = root.querySelector('[data-cockpit-launch]');
    if (!launch) return;
    var going = false;
    launch.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.defaultPrevented || e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (going) return;
      going = true;
      var href = launch.getAttribute('href');
      root.classList.add('is-launching');
      window.setTimeout(function () { window.location.assign(href); }, 1000);
    });
    // Coming back with the back button must not leave the cabin mid-launch.
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', function () { going = false; root.classList.remove('is-launching'); });
  }

  function boot() {
    var root = document.querySelector('[data-cockpit]');
    if (!root) return;
    render(document);
    wireMotion(root);
    document.addEventListener('pypath:progress', function () { render(document); });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot, { once: true });
  else boot();
```

```js
/* The cockpit replaces the plain heading block. Each light carries its unit's

   without loading the course manifest. */
function cockpit(course) {

  }).join('\n');

</div>

}
```

```css
/* PyPath — the cockpit at the top of /data.html. Space is dark in both site
   themes, so these tokens do not switch with data-theme. */
.cockpit {
  --ck-space: #120c1c;
  --ck-space-2: #21162f;
  --ck-frame: #2b1e3e;
  --ck-frame-hi: #4a3566;
  --ck-ink: #f1ecf8;
  --ck-muted: #d4c8e1;
  --ck-violet: #a78bfa;
  --ck-lamp: #f2bc63;
  --look-x: 0;
  --look-y: 0;
  position: relative;
  padding: 1.25rem 0 2rem;
}
.cockpit__window {
  position: relative;
  min-height: clamp(320px, 52vh, 520px);
  margin-inline: clamp(12px, 3vw, 40px);
  border-radius: 40px 40px 24px 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 70% 10%, var(--ck-space-2), var(--ck-space) 70%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px var(--ck-frame), 0 0 0 12px var(--ck-frame-hi), 0 30px 60px rgb(18 12 28 / .35);
  isolation: isolate;
}
.cockpit__space { position: absolute; inset: -6%; z-index: 0; }
.cockpit__stars { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-repeat: repeat; }
.cockpit__stars--far { background-image: radial-gradient(1px 1px at 20px 30px, #fff8 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 140px 90px, #fff6 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 260px 40px, #fff7 50%, transparent 51%); background-size: 300px 160px; transform: translate(calc(var(--look-x) * -6px), calc(var(--look-y) * -4px)); }
.cockpit__stars--mid { background-image: radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 60px 120px, #fffa 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 300px 20px, #fff9 50%, transparent 51%); background-size: 420px 220px; transform: translate(calc(var(--look-x) * -12px), calc(var(--look-y) * -8px)); }
.cockpit__stars--near { background-image: radial-gradient(2px 2px at 120px 60px, #fff 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(2px 2px at 480px 200px, #ffffffd0 50%, transparent 51%); background-size: 560px 300px; transform: translate(calc(var(--look-x) * -20px), calc(var(--look-y) * -14px)); }
.cockpit__planet { position: absolute; left: -20%; right: -20%; bottom: -78%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(60% 40% at 50% 10%, #3d2a63, #21162f 70%); box-shadow: 0 -6px 40px rgb(167 139 250 / .35); transform: translate(calc(var(--look-x) * -10px), calc(var(--look-y) * -6px)); }
.cockpit__moon { position: absolute; right: 8%; top: 10%; width: clamp(140px, 24vw, 300px); height: auto; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgb(167 139 250 / .35)); transform: translate(calc(var(--look-x) * -16px), calc(var(--look-y) * -10px)); }
.cockpit__frame { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - 5px), var(--ck-frame) calc(50% - 5px), var(--ck-frame) calc(50% + 5px), transparent calc(50% + 5px)); border-radius: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgb(167 139 250 / .25), inset 0 0 80px rgb(0 0 0 / .45); }
.cockpit__hud { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding-block: clamp(1.5rem, 6vh, 4rem); color: var(--ck-ink); }
.cockpit__hud h1 { color: var(--ck-ink); margin: .25rem 0 .75rem; max-width: 14ch; }
.cockpit__hud .lead { color: var(--ck-muted); max-width: 46ch; }
.cockpit__hud .breadcrumb a { color: var(--ck-muted); }
.cockpit__panel { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 1rem 2rem; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ck-frame-hi), var(--ck-frame)); color: var(--ck-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .12); }
.cockpit__panel-label { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ck-muted); }
.cockpit__lights { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.cockpit__light { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a1226; border: 2px solid #5b4778; color: var(--ck-muted); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }
.cockpit__light[data-state="done"] { background: var(--ck-lamp); border-color: #ffe2a8; color: #21162f; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgb(242 188 99 / .7); }
.cockpit__light[data-state="current"] { border-color: var(--ck-violet); color: var(--ck-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(167 139 250 / .35); }
.cockpit__light:focus-visible, .cockpit__launch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset: 3px; }
.cockpit__launch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; min-height: 52px; padding: .75rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ck-lamp); color: #21162f; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #b98a3c; }
.cockpit__launch:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #b98a3c; }
.cockpit__launch-icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #21162f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(33 22 47 / .25); }

@media (max-width: 559px) {
  .cockpit__window { border-radius: 28px 28px 18px 18px; min-height: 360px; }
  .cockpit__moon { top: auto; bottom: 18%; right: -6%; width: 46vw; opacity: .9; }
  .cockpit__panel { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .cockpit__launch { justify-content: center; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .cockpit__stars, .cockpit__planet, .cockpit__moon { transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); }
  .cockpit__stars--far { animation: ck-drift 120s linear infinite; }
  .cockpit__stars--mid { animation: ck-drift 80s linear infinite; }
  .cockpit__light[data-state="current"] { animation: ck-blink 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .cockpit.is-launching .cockpit__window { animation: ck-shake 120ms linear 6; }
  .cockpit.is-launching .cockpit__stars { animation: ck-streak 900ms cubic-bezier(.5, 0, .9, .4) forwards; }
  .cockpit.is-launching .cockpit__moon, .cockpit.is-launching .cockpit__planet { transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(.5, 0, .9, .4); transform: translateY(70%); }
}
@keyframes ck-drift { to { background-position: -600px 0; } }
@keyframes ck-blink { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgb(167 139 250 / .15), 0 0 16px rgb(167 139 250 / .6); } }
@keyframes ck-shake { 25% { transform: translate(1px, -1px); } 75% { transform: translate(-1px, 1px); } }
@keyframes ck-streak { to { transform: scaleY(6) translateY(10%); opacity: .6; } }
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Browser check**

Create `tests/browser/cockpit.mjs`:

```js
/* /data.html cockpit: lights, launch target, modifier clicks, reduced motion.
   Run against npm run serve: node tests/browser/cockpit.mjs [base] */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
const base = process.argv[2] || 'http://localhost:8080';
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const seed = (progress) => (p) => {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('pypath.locale', 'en');
    if (p) { localStorage.setItem(p.lessonsKey, p.lessons); localStorage.setItem('pypath-unit-tests', p.tests); }
  } catch {}
};
try {
  const lessonsKey = 'pypath-progress-lessons'; // LESSON_PROGRESS_KEY in storage-keys.js
  const unit1 = await (await fetch(`${base}/assets/data/curriculum-data.json`)).json();
  const paths = unit1.lessons.filter((l) => l.unit === 1).map((l) => l.path);
  const lessons = JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(paths.map((p) => [p, { passed: true, done: ['x'] }])));
  for (const [name, progress, expectHref] of [
    ['new learner', null, '/data/unit-1.html'],
    ['unit 1 finished', { lessonsKey, lessons, tests: JSON.stringify({ 'data-1': { best: 88 } }) }, '/data/unit-2.html'],
    ['corrupt storage', { lessonsKey, lessons: '{oops', tests: '[1,2' }, '/data/unit-1.html'],
  ]) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
    await context.addInitScript(seed(progress), progress);
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const errors = [];
    page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(String(e)));
    await page.goto(`${base}/data.html`);
    await page.waitForSelector('[data-cockpit-launch]');
    await page.waitForTimeout(400);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-cockpit-launch]').getAttribute('href'), expectHref, name);
    assert.deepEqual(errors, [], name);
    if (name === 'unit 1 finished') {
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.cockpit__light[data-unit="1"]').getAttribute('data-state'), 'done');
      // Modifier click: no animation, normal browser behaviour.
      await page.locator('[data-cockpit-launch]').click({ modifiers: ['Meta'] });
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.cockpit.is-launching').count(), 0);
      // Plain click animates then navigates once.
      const nav = page.waitForURL(`**${expectHref}`);
      await page.locator('[data-cockpit-launch]').click();
      await page.locator('[data-cockpit-launch]').click({ force: true });
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.cockpit.is-launching').count(), 1);
      await nav;
    }
    console.log(`${name}: launch -> ${expectHref}`);
    await context.close();
  }
  const reduced = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  const page = await reduced.newPage();
  await page.goto(`${base}/data.html`);
  await page.waitForSelector('[data-cockpit-launch]');
  await page.locator('[data-cockpit-launch]').click();
  await page.waitForURL('**/data/unit-1.html', { timeout: 2000 });
  console.log('reduced motion: launch navigates at once');
  await reduced.close();
} finally { await browser.close(); }
```

Run with `npm run serve` up: `node tests/browser/cockpit.mjs` → all lines print, exit 0. Note `fetch` here runs in Node 18+ against the local server.

Reduced motion navigates at once because `wireMotion()` returns early, so the click is an ordinary link click.
